{{Quote|We suffer a great many losses in these battles. Too many.|Luminara Unduli, on the Clone Wars|<ref name="Legacy of Terror">{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}</ref>}}
'''Luminara Unduli''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Mirialan]] [[Gender|female]] [[Jedi Master]] during the final days of the [[Jedi Order]]. She commanded the [[41st Elite Corps]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]], and was the master of [[Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee]]. Together, they fought in numerous battlefields of the [[Clone Wars]], before Offee turned against the Jedi Order and [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombed]] the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]], much to the horror of Unduli.

At the end of the war, Unduli fought in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]]. She was arrested and [[Death|executed]] after the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]] issued [[Order 66]] and destroyed the Jedi Order. The [[Galactic Empire]] would later use her remains to attract and kill any Jedi that survived Order 66. One such trap was laid for [[Kanan Jarrus]] and the [[Spectres|crew]] of the ''[[Ghost]]'', who believed Unduli was alive and being [[Spire (Stygeon Prime)|imprisoned]] on [[Stygeon Prime]]. They mounted a [[Duel on Stygeon Prime|rescue mission]], only to discover that it was a trap by the [[The Grand Inquisitor|Grand Inquisitor]]. The rebels escaped with the knowledge that Unduli was dead and spread the word to dispel the ruse, preventing any more deaths in her name.

Many years after her demise, Unduli's voice was among many heard by the Jedi aspirant [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] as she [[Battle of Exegol|faced down]] her grandfather, Darth Sidious, on [[Exegol]], telling her to find the light.

==Biography==
===Jedi in peace time===
[[File:Shatterpoint-Luminara-Barriss-wallpaper.png|thumb|left|250px|Luminara Unduli with her Padawan, Barriss Offee]]
Lumianra Unduli was born on [[Mirial]] and was taken to become a [[Jedi]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> Around [[41 BBY]],<ref name="Dark Temple Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the flashback events of [[Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple 5|''Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple'' 5]] to [[41 BBY]].</ref> Luminara Unduli fought the [[Daa Security Forces]] on [[Ontotho]] along with five other Jedi.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple 5">[[Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple 5|''Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple'' 5]]</ref> During her [[time]] as a Jedi, Unduli took on at least two [[Padawan]]s, one being fellow [[Mirialan]] [[Barriss Offee]];<ref name="Helmet Collection 60 databank">{{HelmetCollectionCite|60|Databank A-Z}}</ref> which was in keeping with the traditions of her people<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> as only [[Mirialan]] Jedi were able to train Mirialan Padawans due to a special agreement with the [[Jedi Order]],<ref name="Helmet Collection 60 databank" /> although ultimately it was possible for non-Mirialans to take one on.<ref name="A Test of Courage">''[[The High Republic: A Test of Courage]]''</ref> Both Unduli and Offee were also considered to be [[Jedi Vanguard]]s.<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref>

At one point, Offee was sent by her master Unduli to retrieve an old book. During the quest, she encountered a creature and many traps. When she finally reached the place where the book was, she picked up the book and it turned to sand. She later returned and told her master that she had failed. Unduli told Offee that she didn't fail because she never expected Offee to bring her back, it was about the journey and everything she did to find the book.<ref name="Tales from Wild Space: The Journey">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=20|story=Tales from Wild Space: The Journey}}</ref>

After the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination attempt]] on [[Naboo]] [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], she attended a meeting between the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] and [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] about the possibility of war between the Republic and the Separatists under [[Count]] [[Dooku]].<ref name="Episode II" /> She also met a [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi youngling]], [[Kanan Jarrus|Caleb Dume]], who saw her as a "brave, compassionate, disciplined" Jedi and who respected her greatly.<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters">{{Rebels|Rise of the Old Masters}}</ref> Luminara later came to serve as a mentor for both Dume and [[Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="Galactic Explorer's Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>

During the [[Separatist Crisis]], Unduli, along with Offee, sat in on a meeting between the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] and [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who discussed the growing influence of the [[Separatist Crisis|Secessionist Movement]], and the threat of an imminent war between them and the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Episode II" />

Later, Unduli was present in Chancellor [[Emperor's office|Palpatine's office]] along with other [[senator]]s and Jedi as the issue of whether Palpatine should take supreme executive powers was debated.<ref name="Episode II" /> Additionally, She helps [[Mace Windu]] topple the [[warlord]] [[Guattako]] the Grim on [[Oosalon]].<ref name="The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
====First Battle of Geonosis====
[[File:WinduFistoUnduli-JOTRMaceWindu1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Unduli fought in the Battle of Geonosis.]]
When it became apparent that a full-fledged [[Clone Wars|military conflict]] between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems would occur, Obi-Wan Kenobi was captured by the Confederacy on [[Geonosis]], and Unduli and her Padawan joined Master Mace Windu quickly launched a rescue mission.<ref name="Episode II" />

Housed within the packed arena were Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Senator Amidala, who were to be tried and executed by the Confederacy leaders assembled on the world. As over two hundred Jedi crept into the arena, they ignited their lightsabers in a challenge to [[Count of Serenno|Count]] Dooku, the leader of the Confederacy, who was personally overseeing the planned execution. A heated but short battle followed; over half of the assembled Jedi Knights fell in battle before Dooku called his forces to a halt. After the Jedi survivors rejected an offer of surrender in exchange for their lives, Dooku prepared to order their deaths and his forces prepared to shoot them down. Unduli raised [[Luminara's lightsaber|her lightsaber]], prepared to die fighting, but she and the others were saved by the arrival of [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]], accompanied by the newly-created [[Grand Army of the Republic]] in several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|gunships]]. When the gunships landed, Unduli boarded one alongside Masters [[Saesee Tiin]] and [[Shaak Ti]] and was airlifted to safety.<ref name="Episode II" />

Following the battle, Unduli accompanied Masters Windu and Koon to a meeting with Chancellor Palpatine about rescuing [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the]] Hutt's infant son, [[Rotta]].<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> She was then given command of the [[9th Assault Corps]] and its subordinate [[41st Elite Corps]],<ref name="Force Users">{{EncyclopediaCite|Mace Windu and Other Users of the Force}}</ref> and began to work closely with [[Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)|Gree]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> She and Offee fought against a Separatist [[ambush at Ilum]] four [[Standard month|months]] into the conflict, leading to Yoda saving them both when the [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)|Ilum temple]] was nearly destroyed.<ref name="Force Users" /> During the [[Malevolence Campaign|''Malevolence'' Campaign]], Unduli [[Battle near the Kaliida Nebula|dealt]] with [[Unidentified CIS fleet|Separatist reinforcements]] to prevent them helping General [[Grievous]] and his flagship from escaping. This prevented Unduli's fleet group from assisting Master Kenobi's and Skywalker's fleet from destroying both the ''Malevolence'' and Grievous.<ref name="DM">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Afterward, just a few months later, she [[Duel on Nadiem|confronted]] the [[Kaleesh]] General himself on [[Nadiem]] in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Force Users" />

====Duel with Ventress====
{{Quote|This assassin, I've… I've never faced an adversary like her. I should have listened to your advice.|Unduli to Ahsoka Tano, now knowing Asajj Ventress' capabilities|audio=IShouldHaveListened-CoD.flac|<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />}}
Later on, Unduli traveled to [[Rodia]] to escort captured [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] to Coruscant for trial. The Jedi Master was joined by Anakin Skywalker's Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano]]. Aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tranquility]]'', Unduli spearheaded the interrogations of the viceroy, whose denial of information cost Tano her patience. The Padawan threatened Gunray with her lightsaber, and though Unduli scolded the Padawan for using fear as a weapon, the viceroy agreed to "negotiate." Before any information could be gleaned, the ''Tranquility'' was attacked by [[Asajj Ventress]] and a battle droid squad, who had arrived to rescue Gunray.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />

[[File:Luminara_CoD.png|thumb|left|300px|Unduli facing Asajj Ventress]]
After Unduli and Clone Commander Gree managed to destroy the army of [[B2-series super battle droid|super battle droids]], the Jedi Master sensed that Tano was in danger and rushed to meet with her. Unduli arrived to assist the Padawan in confronting Ventress, who was cornered. However, while "surrendering," Ventress activated [[thermal detonator]]s that she had planted in the [[Star Destroyer]]'s reactor room, crippling the [[cruiser]], and escaped to the ravaged engine room. Although Tano offered to help, noting her past run-ins with Ventress and stating that the [[assassin]] was "too powerful for any one Jedi," Unduli unwisely pursued the assassin on her own, leaving Tano to guard Gunray.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />

Finding and engaging Ventress in [[lightsaber combat]], Unduli was hampered by a wound to the left eye early in the battle and was eventually trapped beneath several pipes the Dark Acolyte collapsed on her from the ceiling, though she put up a good fight nonetheless. As Ventress moved to deal the killing blow, the Jedi Master was saved by the timely arrival of Tano, who had decided to disobey her orders in the interest of helping Unduli. The Mirialan accepted the Padawan's help for the continuing duel, but in the end, Ventress escaped with [[Senate Commando]] [[Captain]] [[Faro Argyus]], who had defected to the Separatists and freed Gunray from Republic custody. Unduli and Tano transmitted the signal of the [[Consular-class light cruiser|Republic cruiser]] that the Separatists had used to escape the ''Tranquility'' to Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto]],<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" /> who tracked Gunray to the third moon of [[Vassek]].<ref name="Lair of Grievous Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode010.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lair of Grievous}}</ref> Unduli apologized to Tano for not taking her advice before the Padawan departed to rendezvous with her own Master.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />

Unduli had her next [[Confrontation on Alzoc III|battle with Ventress]] on [[Alzoc III]], where she was joined by fellow Jedi [[Aayla Secura]] and managed to defeat Ventress with Secura's aid. Unduli and Ventress fought many more times over the rest of the war. Of all Separatist leaders, Ventress was the one Unduli battled most often.<ref name="Force Users" />

====Return to Geonosis====
{{Quote|Gentlemen, if you are quite finished, we have a battle to begin.|Luminara Unduli, to Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|audio=IfYouAreQuiteFinished-LaPR.flac|<ref name="L@PR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>}}
[[File:Luminara_Unduli_Barriss_Offee_TCW.png|thumb|right|300px|Luminara Unduli returns to Geonosis with her Padawan]]
Unduli later returned to Geonosis to help Masters [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi [[Second Battle of Geonosis|destroy]] [[Poggle the Lesser]]'s [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|new droid foundry]] there. She attended the mission briefing before the invasion made planetfall and interceded in Kenobi and Skywalker's casual sniping, reminding them that they had a battle to fight.<ref name="L@PR" /> Along with her Padawan, Barriss Offee, she joined Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano in the storming of the droid factory. While she and Skywalker acted as diversions, the two Padawans Offee and Tano made their way through the vast underground catacombs to destroy the factory. Unduli cut her way through dozens of battle droids alongside Skywalker, demonstrating her mastery of both her lightsaber and the Force, but was forced into a temporary retreat after the Separatists unveiled their new super tanks, whose ray shields and warhead launchers decimated the Republic ranks. Alongside Skywalker, Unduli placed explosives along the underside of the bridge the tanks were crossing and then watched as the detonation sent the tanks plummeting to their doom.<ref name="WF">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>

She and Anakin then watched in horror as the factory exploded and collapsed with their Padawans inside; Unduli believed that Offee died and prepared herself to accept the loss, but Anakin insisted that they are still alive. He is proven right by a faint signal from Ahsoka underneath a large pile of rubble. Ecstatic to see her Padawan alive, Unduli congratulated both on the success of their mission but also counseled Skywalker on being prepared for the time when he would have to let his apprentice go.<ref name="WF" />

[[File:Luminara-LoT.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Unduli prepares to pursue Poggle on Geonosis]]
Following this, Unduli went in search of Poggle the Lesser, who had retreated into the catacombs of an ancient temple. While she and a trooper searched the temple, a sandstorm prohibited reinforcements from reaching their positions. While communicating with Masters Kenobi and Mundi via [[hologram]], Unduli's clone trooper was killed by the undead hordes of the mysterious Hive Queen [[Karina the Great]] and Unduli cut the communication whilst turning to face her attackers. Having been knocked unconscious and captured, the Jedi Master was taken before Karina. Jedi Kenobi and Skywalker came to her rescue; they were not far off when Unduli regained consciousness and wrestled her way out of the zombies' reach, only to find her usually crippling moves had no effect on the undead warriors. Realizing what they were up against, she contacted Kenobi to warn him not to come after her but was cut off as the zombies overwhelmed her.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />

Unduli was imprisoned in Karina's abode and was held in an energy trap as the Geonosians prepared to infect her with brain worms. However, Skywalker and Kenobi, who had disregarded her warnings and continued their search with the help of their clone troopers, came to the rescue. Unduli, much to her chagrin, nearly found herself infected due to Kenobi's eagerness to see how the process worked, but resigned herself under the hope that it was all part of the plan. With Kenobi and Commander Cody delaying the zombies and the Queen, Skywalker freed Unduli and the two captured Poggle. Cody and his troopers shot down the cave support, burying the Queen and taking Poggle prisoner.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" /> Unduli, along with Skywalker, Kenobi, and Mundi took Poggle to Coruscant. She and Skywalker allowed their apprentices to make supply run from [[Ord Cestus]]'s [[Ord Cestus medical station|medical station]] to Master Windu's forces on [[Dantooine]].<ref name="Brain Invaders">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>

===Order 66 and later execution===
{{Quote|Yes, I'm afraid Master Luminara died with the Republic, but her bones continue to serve the Empire, luring the last Jedi to their ends.|The Grand Inquisitor|<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" />}}
[[File:LuminaraUnduliDelta7B-SWZ.png|thumb|right|270px|Unduli piloting her Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class interceptor on Kashyyyk.]]
After Offee [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|betrayed]] the Jedi Order out of anger at its involvement in the Clone War,<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref> Unduli was shaken by what her apprentice had done. To try to find solace, she focused her attention on the [[Wookiee]] [[city]] [[Kachirho]], which had been damaged by Confederate attacks, on the planet [[Kashyyyk]]. As she focused on repairing the damages to city and preparing new defenses for it, she ultimately spent months preparing for the coming [[Battle of Kashyyyk|Separatist invasion of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> During the [[Outer Rim Sieges]], she served alongside Yoda, Republic forces, and [[Wookiee warrior]]s during the engagement<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> she had been preparing for,<ref name="Battles" /> directing her forces just prior to the battle's commencement.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> While on the Wookiee homeworld, she piloted a [[Luminara Unduli's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|green Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] along with a [[Color|green]]-plated [[astromech droid]] [[Pilot|copilot]].<ref name="Delta-7B">{{FFGXW2|set=Delta-7 Aethersprite Expansion Pack|cardname=Luminara Unduli}}</ref>

Unduli led her forces into battle against the attacking Droid Army.<ref name="The Lightsaber Collection">''[[Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection]]''</ref> In the midst of the battle, Darth Sidious issued [[Order 66]], a command ordering all clone troopers to kill their Jedi commanders. Above her, in the elevated command center, Master [[Yoda]] was formulating his own directives when he also sensed the deaths of so many Jedi.<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> On the [[beach]], Luminara was directing the hunt for the wounded, and the clones turned against her and the Wookiees that raced to her rescue.<ref name="The End of the Clone Wars">{{EncyclopediaCite|The End of the Clone Wars}}</ref> Unduli evaded the fate that many of her fellow Jedi had,<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" /> though for years it was believed she had been shot down by her troops on Kashyyyk.<ref name="Databank" /> In actuality, Unduli had been taken into custody by the Empire.<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" /> The Jedi Order was destroyed, and Sidious declared himself [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] and transformed the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Episode III" />

After a short time in the prison known as the [[Spire (Stygeon Prime)|Spire]] on [[Stygeon Prime]], she was [[Death penalty|executed]] in her cell in the presence of [[the Grand Inquisitor]], who then held her remains for future purposes of the Empire.<ref name="Dave Filoni Luminara">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2014/10/28/star-wars-rebels-dave-filoni-on-the-luminara-twist-in-rise-of-the-old-masters|text=''Star Wars Rebels'': Dave Filoni on the Luminara Twist in "Rise of the Old Masters"|archivedate=20200509105550}}</ref>

===Postmortem===
{{Quote|One of the Republic's greatest peacekeepers, Jedi Master Luminara Unduli, is alive.|Gall Trayvis|<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" />}}
After her death, rumors began to spread that Unduli had survived the Clone Wars and was still alive, with those rumors existing<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" /> as of [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> In reality, the Empire used Unduli's remains to lure Jedi survivors into traps so they could be killed, corrupting the Mirialan Master's memory. One such trap was laid by the Inquisitor with Unduli's remains still held in the Spire. In an attempt to trick Jedi survivor Kanan Jarrus,<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" /> who had previously gone by the name Caleb Dume,<ref name="Kanan Jarrus Databank">{{Databank|kanan-jarrus|Kanan Jarrus/Caleb Dume}}</ref> and the [[Spectres|rebel crew]] of the ''[[Ghost]]'' into a trap, former Imperial Senator [[Gall Trayvis]],<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" /> a secret operative of the Empire,<ref name="Vision of Hope">{{Rebels|Vision of Hope}}</ref> 'hacked' a [[HoloNet News]] transmission to proclaim that Unduli was being held in the [[Stygeon system]]. Jarrus and the crew determined that they would mount a [[Duel on Stygeon Prime|rescue mission]] to save Unduli. Jarrus, who remembered Unduli as a compassionate and capable Jedi, especially wanted to find her as he believed she would be a better teacher for his apprentice, [[Ezra Bridger]], than he had been.<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" />

[[File:LuminaraUnduliRemains-RiseOfTheOldMasters.png|thumb|left|250px|Unduli's remains, held in the Spire]]
The rebels infiltrated the Spire, with Jarrus and Bridger leading the search for the Jedi Master. They found the cell she appeared to be held in, where they saw a physical manifestation of her. Jarrus could sense her presence, but something about it felt wrong. Her physical manifestation (in reality a hologram) soon disappeared into a case on the wall, which contained Unduli's desiccating remains. It was at that moment that the Inquisitor revealed himself and attempted to kill the two Jedi, but the rebels were able to escape. The experience nonetheless helped teach Jarrus that he could train Bridger himself. Having survived the Inquisitor's trap, Jarrus resolved to spread the word that Unduli was dead and news of her imprisonment was being used as bait for exiled Jedi.<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|In the night, find the light, Rey.|Luminara Unduli to Rey|<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>}}
During Jarrus's vision during his second visit to [[Lothal]]'s [[Lothal Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]], a vision of Unduli's lightsaber was present in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi Temple dojo|dojo]].<ref name="Shroud of Darkness TG">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/shroud-of-darkness-trivia-gallery|text="Shroud of Darkness" Trivia Gallery}}</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker]] eventually learned about Unduli and her fate, and wrote of her in his book, [[The Secrets of the Jedi]].<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi">''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Jedi]]''</ref> Unduli was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', a survival guide written by [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[DK-RA-43]].<ref name="Galactic Explorer's Guide" />

In [[35 ABY]], during the [[Battle of Exegol]], Unduli's voice was heard by [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] among the voices of many Jedi of the past who aided her with killing the resurrected Darth Sidious, with Unduli advising that the girl seek the light.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Dialogue|Anakin Skywalker|Looks like a good way to get lost, if you ask me.|Luminara Unduli|For the unprepared perhaps, but I have instructed Barriss to memorize the labyrinth, all 200 junctions.|Anakin Skywalker|You always were thorough.|Luminara Unduli|It pays for one to be prepared. Right, Barriss?|Barriss Offee|Especially when other people's lives depend on your success.|attr=Anakin Skywalker, Luminara Unduli, and Barriss Offee|src=<ref name="WF" />}}
[[File:LuminaraUnduli-SWM41.png|thumb|right|250px|Unduli was a patient and disciplined master to Offee.]]
Luminara Unduli was a Mirialan female Jedi Master who was 1.76 [[meter]]s (5 [[foot|feet]], 9 inches) tall,<ref name="Join the Battle" /> with black [[hair]],<ref name="Episode II" /> blue [[eye]]s and green skin,<ref name="DiD-book" /> with a black [[tattoo]] on her chin which symbolized personal achievement.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

A wise protector<ref name="Delta-7B" /> of the Galactic Republic and Jedi Order, Unduli was known as a Jedi Master<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" /> of great patience, bravery, compassion, and discipline. She was held in great esteem by her colleagues<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" /> and was a trusted advisor to both the Jedi Council and the Republic. Unduli had mastered control of her emotions as well as her physical abilities, making her a model Jedi.<ref name="Base Series 1">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Luminara Unduli - Galactic Republic}}</ref> Upon facing with the possibility of her Padawan dying, she was prepared to let go of her when the time comes, mourning her but also celebrating her through her memory.<ref name="WF" /> She was able to keep a cool head amid dangerous situations, even when about to be forcibly infected with brain worms,<ref name="Legacy of Terror" /> and refused to show anger or even raise her voice. However, Barriss Offee's treason shook Unduli and forced the Jedi Master to try to find solace on Kashyyyk.<ref name="Battles" /> Though confident in her abilities as a Jedi, she greatly underestimated the prowess of the assassin Asajj Ventress and was only saved by the timely arrival of Ahsoka Tano, whose advice she had disregarded. However, she was humble enough to admit her mistake and was genuinely thankful to Tano for rescuing her.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />

As she was about to be infected with a brain worm, Unduli displayed discomfort with the prospect but nevertheless was able to make a joke about whether it was part of Obi-Wan Kenobi's plan.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" /> Indeed, Unduli was humorous on occasion, at one point stifling a snort of laughter at Skywalker's "simple logic" approach to dealing with droids,<ref name="WF" /> and when she requested that some strategic planning be saved for her so she didn't feel left out.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:Luminara_Unduli_SoR.png|thumb|left|250px|Unduli was a master at Form III, also known as Soresu]]
Unduli was an extremely powerful and skilled [[Force-sensitive]] Jedi Master,<ref name="Join the Battle" /> with few able to match her. Her skill with a lightsaber allowed her to duel Asajj Ventress on an even footing even with one eye impaired.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" /> She was also skilled in unarmed combat, as demonstrated when she was disarmed and captured by undead Geonosian warriors, she was able to put up a decent fight despite being severely outnumbered and in handcuffs.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" /> Unduli possessed at least some knowledge of [[Form II]], as she was able to recognize it when Ventress applied it against her in battle.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" /> Unduli wore black robes and a headdress along with brass-colored armbands and a sash, the latter two embossed with ornate symbols. She wielded a green-bladed lightsaber.<ref name="Episode II" /> Unduli also was skilled at [[Mind probe (Force power)|mind-probing]], diplomacy and was known for her extreme physical flexibility.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

Unduli's bones somehow still radiated her presence in the Force many years after her death, albeit corrupted slightly.<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters" />

==Equipment==
Unduli wore [[Jedi apparel|Jedi Master robes]] with a [[Clothing|tabard]] from her [[homeworld]].<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> She piloted a green [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] with the help of an astromech droid.<ref name="Delta-7B" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MaryOyaya-Luminara.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Mary Oyaya in costume as Luminara while on set during the filming of Attack of the Clones]]
Luminara Unduli was played by [[Mary Oyaya]] in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Fay David]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection">''[[Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection]]''</ref> Prior to her appearance in ''Attack of the Clones'', [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Unduli]] first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] novel ''[[Cloak of Deception]]''.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> Concept art of Unduli and Barriss Offee was done by [[Dermot Power]]. In Power's art work, the two are depicted with chalk white skin and the image is featured in ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]'' next to images of Kit Fisto with similar skin, who was originally designed as a potential Sith.<ref name="Art of AotC">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Indeed the image is also featured on Power's website under the section "Sith".<ref name="DPower">{{WebCite|url=https://dermotpower.com/star-wars-episode-2attack-of-the-clones|work=[[Dermot Power]]'s website|text=Star Wars Episode 2:Attack of the Clones|archivedate=20260211111619}}</ref> Unduli was originally to have been depicted in ''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' being killed as part of Order 66, but this scene was cut along with the deaths of Barriss Offee and Shaak Ti. Unused footage from ''Attack of the Clones'' was going to be used for this appearance.<ref name="CC">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ccbanana.com/main/interviews/starwars1.htm|text=C.C. Banana Interviews the Stars of ''STAR WARS''!|archivedate=20070512233219}}</ref>

Unduli was voiced by [[Olivia d'Abo]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. 

The female Jedi mentioned by [[Rafa Martez]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|season 7]] episode "[[Dangerous Debt]]" who talked to the [[Martez family|sisters]] after their parents died is described as having dark robes and green skin like Unduli, but it has not been explicitly confirmed whether that was her or not.<ref name="Dangerous Debt">{{TCW|Dangerous Debt}}</ref>
